research_question: Can independently identified stage-1 and stage-2 accumulation variables predict numerical Q.ANT compatibility for unseen hierarchical architectures?
hypothesis: A log-linear model fitted only to Exp027 using log(stage1_terms) and log(stage2_terms) will predict held-out end-to-end logit MAE better than the failed confounded Exp026 model and correctly identify the lower-error region among preregistered unseen architectures.
falsification_criterion: Not supported if the model predicts the wrong held-out ordering and mean absolute prediction error is not improved relative to Exp026's held-out mean absolute prediction error.
limitations: CPU backend only; no photonic hardware performance claim.
